acceptance.given: A compiled Exact Cover mapping contains Atomic Obligations, assertions, selectors, commands, witnesses, and runtime-evidence nodes.

oracle.expected: The Exact Cover validator reports bidirectional coverage for every required node type and zero orphan nodes.
forbidden: Any Atomic Obligation, assertion, selector, command, witness, or runtime-evidence node lacking a relationship.
A passing validation result while an orphan remains.
oracle.observable: The validator result for the orphan-mapping negative fixture exits nonzero and reports the exact-cover binding violation; the unmodified mapping validates without orphan errors.

acceptance.then: The compiled graph has no orphan nodes across its required bidirectional coverage domains.
acceptance.when: The Exact Cover mapping is compiled or validated.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the existing exact-cover negative validator with its isolated reverse-mapping orphan fixture and require its deliberate nonzero outcome.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Make Exact Cover validation reject any orphaned or one-way Atomic Obligation, assertion, selector, command, witness, or runtime-evidence node.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: The read-only mapping contract and non-authorizing result shape remain compatible.

slice_hint.state_transition: An unverified coverage graph becomes a graph with deterministic bidirectional orphan detection.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Exact Cover validation accepts the complete mapping and the isolated orphan fixture is deterministically blocked.

acceptance.given: A package replay request names a repository-relative target that is not supported by the active validator capability.

oracle.expected: The replay command exits nonzero before validation of the target and reports that the target is unsupported.
forbidden: Producing a passing receipt for the unsupported target.
oracle.observable: The targeted replay test invokes an unsupported target and observes a nonzero command result with no successful validation receipt.

acceptance.then: The unsupported target is rejected and no target-dependent replay proceeds.
acceptance.when: A replay or package-validation request identifies an unsupported target.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute the unsupported-target case in the repository-owned skill package replay test and require the replay command's nonzero rejection.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Reject unsupported requested target packages before validator execution, without fallback or target substitution.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Existing supported-target validation and receipt behavior remain unchanged.

slice_hint.state_transition: A replay request with an unsupported target transitions directly to a blocked result rather than validator execution.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: An unsupported target invocation exits nonzero, identifies rejection, and cannot yield a successful replay receipt.

acceptance.given: An actor attempts to publish an acceptance-passed result for an Acceptance run.

oracle.expected: Only deterministic finalization under the current Acceptance lifecycle owner emits the hash-bound acceptance-passed artifact and authorization; non-owner artifacts remain non-authorizing.
forbidden: A non-current lifecycle owner publishing acceptance-passed.
Evidence-only, replay, seed, matrix, review, or Quick Dev artifacts authorizing acceptance-passed.
oracle.observable: The deterministic finalization test verifies the current Acceptance finalization output authorizes acceptance-passed while its candidate and pointer artifacts remain non-authorizing.

acceptance.then: Acceptance-passed publication is restricted to the current Acceptance lifecycle owner.
acceptance.when: Any workflow artifact or actor attempts to publish acceptance-passed.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Exercise the deterministic-finalization authorization boundary and require non-finalization artifacts to retain an empty authorization set.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Restrict acceptance-passed publication to the current Acceptance finalization owner and retain empty authorization sets on non-finalization artifacts.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Lifecycle ownership and the machine-readable authorization-set contract remain compatible.

slice_hint.state_transition: An attempted publication is either denied as non-authorizing or finalized by the current Acceptance owner.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Only the current Acceptance finalization result contains authorizes:["acceptance-passed"]; all other covered artifacts contain authorizes:[].

acceptance.given: The evaluation-seed manifest records the three named seed occurrences.

oracle.expected: Every named seed occurrence has a non-empty missing_labels record in addition to its required provenance, applicability, counterexample-or-explicit-absence, and approved non-baseline classification.
forbidden: A named evaluation seed occurrence without missing labels.
A manifest that passes after a missing_labels field is removed from any named seed occurrence.
oracle.observable: The evaluation-seed validation path rejects a manifest with missing labels removed from one occurrence and accepts the intact three-occurrence manifest.

acceptance.then: Each named evaluation seed occurrence records missing labels.
acceptance.when: An evaluation seed occurrence is recorded or the evaluation-seed manifest is validated.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the evaluation-seed validation selector after removing missing_labels from one named occurrence and require a deterministic validation failure.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Validate missing_labels as a required non-empty field on each of the three named evaluation seed occurrences.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: The existing evaluation-seed manifest remains non-authorizing and retains its three named occurrences.

slice_hint.state_transition: A manifest with unspecified missing-label coverage becomes one whose every named seed is checked for recorded missing labels.
